item.description: Palantir CEO Alex Karp says the rise of Germany's AfD party is due to "very deep and large migration into Germany without the buy-in of the German people, and without an honest discussion of the consequences." "AfD is much stronger than they appear. I have friends who 5 years ago were telling me they would never vote for the AfD, who are voting for the AfD, who are social democrats." "And then when the AfD is polling at 40%—there's another 10 points above that that would vote for them if they weren't the AfD." Via Mathias Döpfner
